component.name: Harmony
component.summary: A native Discord client based on Yapfast

description.p: Harmony is a Rust and Slint desktop chat client based on Yapfast by wiredtenshi and contributors, with Harmony themes and desktop integration. It communicates directly with Discord without embedding a web browser.

Servers, direct messages, threads, forums, friends, voice, screen sharing and GIFs use native controls. Third-party personal-account clients are not authorized by Discord; using them carries account risk.

Check for Harmony releases in Settings → About. On Linux, install the new version with your package manager or replace the AppImage. Original licenses, attribution and corresponding source accompany packages.
